cohort: The study included 168 diabetic mothers diagnosed with pre-existing diabetes who delivered at Hayatabad Medical Complex, Peshawar, and their newborns.
finding: The study found a significant association between maternal outcomes (including mode of delivery, PPH, and genital tract trauma) and neonatal mortality in newborns of diabetic mothers.
mod_finding: Normal delivery was the most common mode of birth among diabetic mothers (47.6%), while 37.5% required cesarean section and 14.9% had instrumental delivery.
cross-section timing: Data was collected retrospectively from medical records for deliveries occurring in the 6 months prior to the study period of January to June 2024.
